own_solution.law: Lossless transmission line: Z0 = sqrt(L'/C') = sqrt(L_tot/C_tot); launched wave V+ = E Z0/(Z0 + Rs); load voltage V+ (1 + Gamma_L), Gamma_L = (RL - Z0)/(RL + Z0)
assumptions: step source switched at t=0 on uncharged line

defect_reasons.other: T2129 ('cut to a length of 120 m') implies the cable may have been shortened, so the stated total L and C may no longer describe it; the answer survives because Z0 depends only on their ratio, but the wording is slightly awkward.

notes: Z0 = sqrt(0.025e-3/10e-9) = sqrt(2500) = 50 ohm. V+ = 10*50/75 = 6.667 V; Gamma_L = 100/200 = 0.5; V_load = 6.667*1.5 = 10.00 V. With extra 42 ohm in series with source: Rs = 67 ohm, V+ = 500/117 = 4.274 V, V_load = 6.410 V. Length enters per-unit-length L' = L/l and C' = C/l and cancels in Z0 (C); it would set the delay only. Lamp circuit is separate (D). Earlier-test sentences D. Pairs TAB4E/T6BEA/TADD9/T8F3D all state 42 ohm; T9B6E/T2129 both 120 m.
